g.text: Y2 and W2: 2 x 2.2k in series, LED and anti-parallel diode, 1k across the optocoupler's input, to C. Output pulled up 10k, 1 uF to GND.

g.desc: Y2 and W2: 2 x 2.2k in series, LED and anti-parallel diode, 1k across the optocoupler's input, to C. Output pulled up 10k, 1 uF to GND.

g.text: 1-wire: DS2482 at 0x18 on SDA/SCL, bus on TB3 with VCC through F2. JP1 and R15 (not fitted) are the rollback to D2 with U2 removed.

g.desc: 1-wire: DS2482 at 0x18 on SDA/SCL, bus on TB3 with VCC through F2. JP1 and R15 (not fitted) are the rollback to D2 with U2 removed.

g.text: Air temperatures: 10.0k 0.1% from 5 V to each NTC on TB2, 1k to A0 and A1, 100n at the pins.

g.text: Arduino headers (5V, GND, A0, A1, A3, SDA, SCL, D2, D8, D9 used) and J1, the 12-pad test row.

g.text: 24 VAC on TB1 (R, C, Y2, W2). F1, D2 TVS, D1 half-wave into C1: VS about 35 V against C (net COM). U1 isolates and feeds the R4's 5V pin.
